plan.rationale: An unregistered successful API route must remain fail-closed.
Only a 204 response receives the empty-body contract.
JSON payloads must reach envelope and payload validation instead of the text budget branch.
A valid success envelope must not be rejected as an invalid envelope.
Unsafe output must be rejected while safe output remains serializable.
Registered routes must not bypass their envelope and payload validators.
Clinical list contracts must preserve the tested 100-item page boundary.
Clinical document and appointment versions must accept the initial version 1.
Clinical bounded text fields must reject empty labels and descriptions.
Remaining list contracts must preserve the tested 200-item page boundary.
Health responses must advertise liveness only with the true literal.
Operational counters and revoked-session counts must allow zero.
Recovery challenge identifiers must preserve the tested 40-character valid boundary.
Password policy must reject values below the minimum length, not values above it.
Password policy must enforce an uppercase character independently of the lowercase rule.
WebAuthn assertions must be rejected once the challenge is no longer pending.
A nonzero WebAuthn counter must advance strictly beyond the registered counter.
The PDP must deny a request whose capability differs from the canonical operation rule.
High-impact requests without a bound approval must remain approval-required.
The PDP must allow only actors whose current role snapshot intersects the descriptor roles.
A resumed migration run must quarantine source drift instead of accepting the changed source.
A migration without an aborted signal must be allowed to enter the execution protocol.
Migration parity must reject a digest mismatch even when row counts happen to match.
A single-currency financial balance must reject mixed currencies instead of reporting a settled amount.
Clinical signing must require an explicitly reviewed document while rejecting draft signatures.
